scope: All 21 expected results, both Academy labs, thesis results/conclusions/annex and reproducible evidence.
guardrails: Do not touch protected T-LANG examples to tune the system before human references and freeze.
Do not substitute synthetic human turns or LLM labels for independent annotation.
Do not treat a contract boundary test as observed scientific workflow infeasibility.
Do not lower thresholds after seeing outputs, hide failures, or reuse development proteins as an intact held-out set.
Use scoped clean evaluation checkouts or an explicit source snapshot without discarding unrelated user edits.
More accounts add credits but do not remove provider permission or per-instance capacity limits.

Direct check of current workbook cells finds no expert references/paraphrases.

milestones.name: Prospective deterministic contract and trace campaign
remaining: Execute Nextflow dry traversal and approved scientific workflows over graph variants where required; static positives alone do not prove R1.5.
Create independent event oracle from test actions, compare permission/admission/protocol ledger including rejection cases.
Generate/export methods solely from complete manifests; verify mandatory fields and unknown-value rejection.
Repeat portable fault injection on newly generated remote bundles.
milestones.limit: Prospective contract labels on one known development protein; not held-out biological annotation or language understanding.

milestones.name: Both-account resource and failure contrasts
requirements: Compare actual Academy capacities and resource observations independently of Helix admission decisions.
Run equivalent fixed workflow/image/profile on both labs with recovered evidence.
Report CPU quotas versus exclusive cores, observed memory versus declared allocation, per-node capacities versus aggregates.
Keep cgroup OOM containment success separate from scientific task success.
Use real limited execution or scheduler capacity contradiction to label feasibility.
completion_proof: Native scheduler test or job output
Measured cgroup configuration and OOM/CPU observables
Helix decisions matched to independent contrasts
Cost/reserve and final stopped/deleted resource states
milestones.limit: 40 engineering hardware/contract contrasts do not substitute for 40 scientifically diverse TRP workflows; state adaptation scope before inference.
milestones.scope_limit: 20 permitted container pressure/containment tests and20 independently capacity-infeasible scheduler requests do not estimate biological workflow false-rejection rate.

milestones.name: Effective model configuration and development pilot
requirements: Verify actual configured provider/model/reasoning at office or equivalent authorized local login.
Run only D-LANG/development inputs, not the 70 held-out drafts.
Use US$10 pilot within US$100 total; record actual calls, token limits, response model/revision, instructions and provider IDs.
Set operational caps from pilot and freeze before reserved inference.
If SSH/provider unavailable, preserve observed errors and continue other milestones; do not silently use another model.

milestones.name: Reserved human-dependent language and intervention evaluation
requirements: Receive and hash first expert workbook delivery; freeze 50 feasible intentions, 100 human paraphrases and 20 out-of-scope requests.
Run three fresh-session replicates in frozen seed orders 20260915/20260916/20260917; retain failures and max3 clarification rounds.
Admissibility/stability≥85% per replicate; actual execution≥95% on50 approved feasible specifications.
Collect≥100 real human turns with context, select whole sessions before classification, send blinded task when real sessions exist.
Compute Cohen kappa≥0.70 using first nonadjudicated independent labels and clustered intervals, paired with task correctness.
completion_proof: Immutable independent first labels and participant agreement
Session-clustered kappa bootstrap and confusion matrix
Actual task correctness and intervention counts together

milestones.name: Structural silent-failure evaluation
requirements: Preserve recovered author originals and their unchanged hashes; no publication of private bundle without redistribution basis.
Develop and validate physical plausibility control independently of confidence alarms; document nonautomatable aspects.
Obtain≥30 pertinent independently reviewed negative controls with comparable check eligibility.
Separate calibration cases/families from reserved structural evaluation; any reuse of observed Pratt outputs for control design is exploratory.
Report sensitivity≥80%, specificity≥90%, evaluable coverage≥90% per group plus conservative detection accounting for missing cases.
milestones.limit: The32beta-solenoid classifications in TableS1 are not32demonstrated failures. All78alarms do not demonstrate discrimination.

milestones.name: Integrated report, reproducibility and completion audit
requirements: Update chapter4results, chapter5conclusions, annex and21result traceability from current Word.
Reconcile stale dependency statements and use red notes for unresolved methodological limitations.
Retain approved background/state-of-art/problem sections except strictly necessary current-ID references.
Report measured rates with exact denominators and intervals; use null/non-evaluable for missing metrics.
English title-only commits without coauthor, no unrelated changes staged.
Confirm both accounts compute stopped or safe teardown after local evidence copies; report residual EBS cost and billing lag.
Do requirement-by-requirement completion audit; keep thesis incomplete while mandatory independent validations remain.
